categories.main_business_segments: Guangzhou Sanfu New Materials Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in surface engineering specialized chemicals and equipment. Its main business segments include electronic chemicals, general electroplating chemicals, and surface engineering specialized equipment. The company serves industries such as PCB manufacturing, passive components, new energy (lithium batteries, photovoltaics), semiconductor, communication electronics, automotive parts, and hardware sanitary products.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company focuses on advanced surface engineering technologies including pulse electroplating, chemical nickel-gold plating, horizontal copper deposition, and composite copper foil electroplating. It develops environmentally friendly, non-toxic chemical formulations (e.g., cyanide-free, chromium-free, phosphorus-free) and integrates chemical products with specialized equipment for synergistic innovation. Production methods for chemicals mainly involve physical mixing and stirring of raw materials, while equipment manufacturing emphasizes precision mechanical design and automation.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are PCB manufacturers, electronics and communication device producers, automotive parts manufacturers, and hardware sanitary product companies. Major end markets include AI servers, 3C electronics, smart automotive electronics, semiconductor packaging, and new energy battery materials. The company has established stable relationships with nearly 1,000 customers, including leading domestic and international PCB and electronics firms.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters and major facilities in Guangzhou and subsidiaries across Jiangxi, Jiangsu, Guangdong, Hainan, and other provinces. It has expanded overseas markets, notably achieving technology export and scale application in Belarus. The company also supports PCB industry clusters in Southeast Asia and maintains sales and service centers covering the Pearl River Delta and Yangtze River Delta regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: Sanfu New Materials operates upstream and midstream in the surface engineering supply chain, providing specialized chemicals and equipment essential for downstream PCB, semiconductor, new energy, and electronics manufacturing. It supplies core materials and manufacturing equipment to processing enterprises that perform surface treatments on products or components.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation in green, efficient, and high-performance surface engineering technologies. Strategic R&D priorities include pulse electroplating, composite copper foil manufacturing, environmentally friendly chemical formulations, and intelligent equipment integration. It pursues a '3+2' business development strategy focusing on electronic chemicals, general electroplating chemicals, equipment, new energy, and specialty chemical sectors, supported by a '3+1' R&D strategy emphasizing talent, equipment, testing, and customer certification.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through direct sales of specialized chemical products and customized surface engineering equipment. The company employs a direct sales model supplemented by limited distribution. It also earns investment income from equity holdings and occasional asset disposals. Sales contracts often include technical service and on-site support, enhancing customer engagement and product adoption.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Sanfu New Materials is a leading domestic provider in the surface engineering specialized chemicals and equipment sector, competing against international giants such as Atotech, Rohm&Haas, and MacDermid Alpha Electronics Solutions. It has achieved significant breakthroughs in pulse electroplating and composite copper foil technologies, gradually breaking foreign monopolies in high-end PCB and new energy materials markets. The company leverages cost advantages, localized service, and rapid innovation to strengthen its market position.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 621 million, a 24.9% increase year-over-year, with a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 12.58 million, narrowing losses compared to prior years. R&D investment increased by 44.5% to RMB 73 million, accounting for 11.76% of revenue. Total assets reached RMB 1.27 billion, with net assets attributable to shareholders at RMB 508 million, reflecting steady growth and ongoing investment in technology and capacity expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Sanfu New Materials offers integrated solutions combining proprietary environmentally friendly surface engineering chemicals and specialized equipment, enabling customers to achieve cost reduction, efficiency improvement, and compliance with green manufacturing standards. Its products feature advanced technologies such as pulse electroplating with superior uniformity and resource savings, and composite copper foil manufacturing with high precision and low stress. The company emphasizes innovation, quality, and localized technical support to differentiate itself in a market dominated by international incumbents.
